rows.spoNote: PD-1 — drives — T-cell exhaustion
rows.assertion: PD-1 signalling contributes to T-cell exhaustion phenotypes (educational graph).
rows.rationale: Exact ISI map REL-R011-drives-P015. HSI seed carries real PMID 16382236 (Barber 2006 Nature) — curated for human Neon Gate C (Check→claim_support=supports→Approve). Still autoApprove=false. Re-check S-P-O (paper also used on expresses-R011).

rows.spoNote: NLRP3 inflammasome — contributes_to — Metabolic inflammation
rows.assertion: NLRP3 inflammasome activation contributes to metabolic inflammation.
rows.rationale: Related-axis ISI map REL-R004-activates-P003. PMID 15030775 (Agostini 2004 Immunity) — curated bridge; metabolic-inflammation object is not a KG node; autoApprove=false; Neon approve+supports is human-only.

rows.spoNote: hs-CRP — biomarker_of — Low-grade chronic inflammation
rows.assertion: hs-CRP is a clinical marker of systemic inflammatory burden.
rows.rationale: Related-axis ISI map REL-P021-produces-B001. PMID 12813013 (Pepys & Hirschfield 2003 JCI) — curated marker-axis bridge; not a T2D edge; autoApprove=false.

rows.spoNote: IL-1 pathway blockade — inhibits — Metabolic inflammation
rows.assertion: IL-1 pathway blockade has been studied for metabolic inflammation (research only).
rows.rationale: Related-axis ISI map REL-I023-targets-M002. PMID 28845751 (Ridker CANTOS 2017 NEJM) — curated discovery bridge; not CDS; autoApprove=false.

rows.spoNote: Type 1 diabetes autoimmunity — associated_with — Islet autoantibodies
rows.assertion: Islet autoantibodies mark autoimmune β-cell targeting in T1D (contrast with T2D).
rows.rationale: Related-axis ISI map REL-B015-predicts_eligibility_for-I013. PMID 31180194 (Herold 2019 NEJM) — curated; T1D contrast with T2D; autoApprove=false.

rows.spoNote: TNF-α — upregulates — Insulin resistance
rows.assertion: TNF-α signalling can impair insulin action in metabolic tissues.
rows.rationale: Related-axis ISI map REL-M001-contributes_to-D001. PMID 11244034 (Feldmann & Maini 2001) — curated; insulin-resistance object absent from ISI; not T2D proof; autoApprove=false.

rows.spoNote: IL-6 — associated_with — Type 2 diabetes mellitus
rows.assertion: Circulating IL-6 is associated with T2D risk and inflammatory tone.
rows.rationale: Related-axis ISI map REL-M003-contributes_to-D001. PMID 18625622 (Emery 2008) — curated; no T2D node in ISI; autoApprove=false.

rows.spoNote: Adipose tissue macrophages — associated_with — Insulin resistance
rows.assertion: Adipose tissue macrophage infiltration associates with insulin resistance.
rows.rationale: Related-axis ISI map REL-C003-produces-M001. PMID 2993897 (Beutler 1985 Nature) — curated; adipose/IR pair not in ISI; autoApprove=false.

rows.spoNote: Systemic glucocorticoids — worsens — Hyperglycemia
rows.assertion: Systemic glucocorticoids can worsen hyperglycemia and unmask diabetes.
rows.rationale: Related-axis ISI map REL-I010-suppresses-P001. PMID 7569976 (Auphan 1995 Science) — curated; hyperglycemia consequence not this paper; Aksh HITL later; autoApprove=false.

rows.spoNote: Low-grade chronic inflammation — bridges_domain — Insulin resistance
rows.assertion: Low-grade chronic inflammation is linked to insulin resistance (immuno-metabolic bridge).
rows.rationale: Chronic inflammation ↔ insulin resistance bridge has no ISI relationship yet. Do not invent a REL-* id.

rows.spoNote: Type 2 diabetes mellitus — associated_with — Infection susceptibility
rows.assertion: T2D is associated with increased susceptibility to certain infections.
rows.rationale: T2D → infection susceptibility — no T2D node / infection-susceptibility edge in ISI KG.

rows.spoNote: Hyperglycemia — worsens — Innate immune dysfunction
rows.assertion: Sustained hyperglycemia can impair aspects of innate immune function.
rows.rationale: Hyperglycemia → innate dysfunction — neither endpoint is an ISI relationship pair yet.

rows.spoNote: Autoimmune–metabolic comorbidity — associated_with — Type 2 diabetes mellitus
rows.assertion: Some autoimmune conditions co-occur with higher T2D risk (bridge shortlist).
rows.rationale: Autoimmune–metabolic comorbidity ↔ T2D — no ISI edge; keep on bridge shortlist as gap.

rows.spoNote: Immune checkpoint therapy — associated_with — Immune-related adverse events
rows.assertion: Immune checkpoint therapy is associated with immune-related adverse events.
rows.rationale: Checkpoint therapy ↔ irAE — irAE is not a modelled ISI disease/event node yet.

rows.spoNote: Immune-related adverse events — associated_with — Hyperglycemia
rows.assertion: Some irAEs and steroid treatment can present with hyperglycemia (bridge-relevant).
rows.rationale: irAE / steroid → hyperglycemia bridge — no ISI relationship; Aksh-facing later.

rows.spoNote: LADA / latent autoimmune diabetes — bridges_domain — Type 2 diabetes mellitus
rows.assertion: LADA can present with adult-onset diabetes phenotypes overlapping T2D clinics.
rows.rationale: LADA ↔ T2D phenotype overlap — no LADA / T2D nodes in ISI KG.

rows.spoNote: TNF-α — contributes_to — Rheumatoid arthritis
rows.assertion: TNF-α contributes to synovial inflammation in rheumatoid arthritis (scope-locked pathway seed — not a partner-signed lock).
rows.rationale: Exact ISI map REL-M001-contributes_to-D001 (TNF → RA). Scope-locked pathway seed; PMID 11244034; autoApprove=false; partnerSigned=false.

rows.spoNote: Anti-CCP antibodies — biomarker_of — Rheumatoid arthritis
rows.assertion: Anti-CCP (ACPA) antibodies are a serologic biomarker used in rheumatoid arthritis workup (scope-locked — not partner-signed / not CDS).
rows.rationale: Anti-CCP → RA biomarker — LOINC-linked (53031-9); PMID 10662881; no durable ISI REL-* yet. Do not invent.

rows.spoNote: Anti-TNF therapy — treats — Rheumatoid arthritis
rows.assertion: Anti-TNF therapy (e.g. infliximab class) improves clinical outcomes in rheumatoid arthritis when combined with methotrexate in established trials (scope-locked — response heterogeneity remains open).
rows.rationale: Anti-TNF therapy → treats → RA (PMID 11087881). No durable ISI REL-* invented for this treatment edge; Gate C pending if/when mapped.

rows.spoNote: IL-6 — contributes_to — Rheumatoid arthritis
rows.assertion: IL-6 pathway signalling contributes to rheumatoid arthritis inflammatory tone (competing axis vs TNF-centric framing).
rows.rationale: IL-6 → RA competing axis. PMID 18625622; related_axis REL-M003-contributes_to-D001; autoApprove=false.

rows.spoNote: Anti-TNF refractory RA phenotype — associated_with — IL-6 pathway axis
rows.assertion: Some patients with inadequate anti-TNF response still show benefit from IL-6 pathway inhibition — supporting competing mechanisms for response heterogeneity (uncertain grade).
rows.rationale: Anti-TNF-refractory phenotype ↔ IL-6 axis (response heterogeneity). PMID 18625622; related_axis to REL-M003 — curator must re-check S-P-O before Neon Gate C (same honesty as PMID 16382236 handoff).

rows.spoNote: Synovial macrophages — upregulates — TNF-α
rows.assertion: Macrophages are a cellular source of TNF-α — relevant to synovial TNF biology in rheumatoid arthritis (entity-slice seed).
rows.rationale: Synovial macrophages → TNF. PMID 2993897; related_axis REL-C003-produces-M001. Foundational macrophage/TNF identity paper — do not overclaim RA histology at Gate C.

rows.spoNote: Anti-drug antibodies to anti-TNF (ADA) — associated_with — Anti-TNF refractory RA phenotype
rows.assertion: Development of anti-infliximab antibodies is associated with reduced clinical response to infliximab in rheumatoid arthritis (immunogenicity competing frame for anti-TNF response heterogeneity).
rows.rationale: Phase 3 ADA → anti-TNF refractory (PMID 16508927). No durable ISI REL-* invented for immunogenicity; keep as competing explanation until partner maps.

rows.spoNote: Anti-drug antibodies to anti-TNF (ADA) — associated_with — Anti-TNF immunogenicity / bioavailability monitoring
rows.assertion: Low early trough infliximab levels and subsequent anti-infliximab antibodies associate with infusion reactions and treatment failure — supporting immunogenicity monitoring as a response-heterogeneity axis (not CDS).
rows.rationale: Phase 3 ADA ↔ immunogenicity/bioavailability monitoring (PMID 17133559). No invented ISI REL-*; hypothesized teaching status.

rows.spoNote: RF/ACPA seropositive RA phenotype — associated_with — Anti-TNF response heterogeneity
rows.assertion: RF and/or anti-CCP positivity has been associated with differential mean DAS28 improvement on anti-TNF therapy in observational cohorts (serology competing frame — direction and magnitude remain contested).
rows.rationale: Phase 3 seropositive phenotype ↔ anti-TNF response heterogeneity (PMID 18375541). Competes with RA-010; no invented REL-*.

rows.spoNote: RF/ACPA seropositive RA phenotype — associated_with — Anti-TNF therapy
rows.assertion: Pooled evidence does not support RF or anti-CCP status as a reliable predictor of clinical response to anti-TNFα agents (competing with single-cohort serology associations).
rows.rationale: Phase 3 meta-analysis: RF/ACPA not associated with anti-TNF effect (PMID 24586782). Competing frame vs RA-009; no invented REL-*.

rows.spoNote: Rheumatoid factor (RF) — biomarker_of — Rheumatoid arthritis
rows.assertion: Rheumatoid factor is a serologic biomarker used in rheumatoid arthritis classification and workup alongside ACPA (scope-locked LOINC marker — not an anti-TNF response predictor by itself).
rows.rationale: Phase 3 RF → RA biomarker — LOINC-linked (11572-5); PMID 20699241; no durable ISI REL-* yet. Do not invent.

rows.spoNote: Methotrexate + anti-TNF combination therapy — treats — Rheumatoid arthritis
rows.assertion: Infliximab plus methotrexate improves clinical and radiographic outcomes versus methotrexate alone in RA — relevant background for interpreting anti-TNF response and immunogenicity in combination regimens.
rows.rationale: Phase 3 MTX + anti-TNF combination treats RA (PMID 10622295 ATTRACT). No durable ISI REL-* invented; background for immunogenicity/response interpretation.

rows.spoNote: Type I interferon pathway — associated_with — Systemic lupus erythematosus
rows.assertion: Type I interferon pathway activation associates with SLE pathophysiology (illustrative — not locked pilot).
rows.rationale: Type I IFN → SLE illustrative pathway — no curated ISI REL-* yet.

rows.spoNote: Antinuclear antibodies (ANA) — biomarker_of — Systemic lupus erythematosus
rows.assertion: ANA testing is used in the serologic workup of SLE (illustrative biomarker — not locked pilot / not CDS).
rows.rationale: ANA → SLE illustrative biomarker — LOINC-linked in HSI; no durable ISI REL-* yet.

rows.spoNote: IL-17 pathway — drives — Psoriasis / psoriatic disease
rows.assertion: IL-17 pathway signalling drives psoriatic skin inflammation (illustrative — not locked pilot).
rows.rationale: IL-17 → psoriasis illustrative pathway — no curated ISI REL-* yet.

rows.spoNote: IL-23 pathway — associated_with — Inflammatory bowel disease
rows.assertion: IL-23 pathway biology associates with IBD inflammatory tone (illustrative — not locked pilot).
rows.rationale: IL-23 → IBD illustrative pathway — no curated ISI REL-* yet.

instructions: Human-only Neon path: Check → claim_support=supports → Approve on the REL.
Do not auto-approve from this checklist into any product KG.
Re-check S-P-O: HSI spoNote is a curator hint; ISI REL endpoints may differ on related_axis maps.
Unmapped rows must not receive invented REL-* ids.
CDS stays closed until curationReview=approved AND hsiGrade=established.
